angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 534,344 km at 188.30 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3107 +/- 0.0153 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 188.30 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.768067 +/- 0.021681 solar radii from Mayo et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-179 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..136M/abstract): 534,344 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.824345 +/- 0.02188 solar masses from Mayo et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-179 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..136M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5015 +/- 50 K from Mayo et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-179 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..136M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mayo et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-179 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..136M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-179.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.583, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, K2-179: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-179 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.03 dex, from Mayo et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..136M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-179 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.52287, from Barros et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016A&A...594A.100B/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 65797082206292224, flags_flame 00: age_flame 11.732568 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 9.112751 to 13.5)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/A+A/635/A43/table2 (Stellar rotation periods from K2 Campaigns 0-18), column Prot: 14.75 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 2 catalogued periods, 2 of them within 20% of it

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/A+A/635/A43/table2 (Stellar rotation periods from K2 Campaigns 0-18), column Prot: 14.75 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place
VizieR J/ApJS/264/12/param (Chromospheric activities from LAMOST and K2), column PRot: 15.04 d, the row 0.4 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, K2-179: projected rotation speed 4.5 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2025A&A...697A.102T)
rotationPeriodMeasuredSource: Measured in this project from the K2 mission's own light curve of campaign 4 (packages/telescope-cli/src/archives/tess/reduce.mts), by the method and criteria of Reinhold & Hekker (2020, A&A 635, A43): 14.62 d, the light swinging by 1.2% as the star turns

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
